scope_limitations: The original Cambridge BCPL guide was retrieved twice with the identical June 24, 2026 revision. The web index showed April 1 edition metadata and direct web rendering timed out. The June native document is the bound evidence.
The frozen registry has no exact local ALGOL 60 identity. The 1963 paper credits ALGOL 60 influence. The CPL entity omits a structural parent edge without asserting historical absence.
The complete pinned B specimen directory had three inspected files. Shared .b suffixes and one C highlighting scope do not establish identity or prove any specimen's original platform.
PDP-11 and MH-TSS report different rvalue widths. PDP-7 lineage details, compiler conformance, current runtime behavior and compatibility are outside this cohort.
The 1963 CPL paper is an informal original design account. The 1966 elementary manual is a different edition. CPL1 compiler behavior and the incomplete reference draft are separate.
The 1967 BCPL reference is Ritchie's edited OCR representation, reproduced with Richards’ permission. The 2026 Cintcode guide and later changes are separately scoped.
